required_detector_contract.detail: Each packet must publish canonical paths/prefixes and immutable write-set hash before parallel eligibility.
Path-disjoint changes can still conflict semantically; owner/domain overlap must be evaluated deterministically.
Current merge-readiness barrier detects base movement; ORCH4 must generalise it across multiple in-flight packet snapshots.
Need deterministic pairwise overlap matrix over write set, semantic owner, frozen contracts, registries and authority surfaces.
ORCH2 remediation forbids frozen-control weakening; ORCH4 must make conflict classification explicit and machine-readable.
Any unresolved or ambiguous conflict must collapse execution to SERIAL_REQUIRED without dropping evidence.
Need immutable conflict/reconciliation receipts sufficient to reproduce the decision from pinned packet/base/head identities.
Conflict graph edges must never grant prerequisites, merge rights, packet-class expansion or scientific authority.
Existing ORCH2 recovery requires reconciliation after possible side effects; multi-packet recovery needs an explicit frontier.
Parallel candidates need deterministic merge-order rules and revalidation after each predecessor integrates.

rollback: Assessment only; no runtime rollback required.
